summary: Goodness in us all, but through realization of intention finding joy and resourcefulness in service, goodness becomes MORE more eviden in many more looking for consciousness through confusion of desire begin to LISTEN to your why. #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Goodness
in us all,
but
through realization of intention
finding joy and
resourcefulness in service,
goodness becomes
MORE
more eviden
in many
more
looking for consciousness
through
confusion of desire
begin to
LISTEN
to your why.
#smallpoems
